description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with dynamic decimal precision and optional credits suffix. It ensures consistent display across the application.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amount with credits appended, defaulting to include credits.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
